# pre-process for elo update
```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tidymodels, elo)
df <- readRDS("./cleaned_data/2025-11-03-atp_matches_best_of_3.rds")
df <- df %>% mutate(
  player1_match_score = ifelse(match_outcome == 0, 0, 1),
  player2_match_score = ifelse(match_outcome == 0, 1, 0)
)
```

# Dynamic K factor implementation
$K_{i}(t) = \frac{\delta}{ ( m_i(t) + \eta ) ^ {\sigma} }$,
Where $m_i(t)$ is the number of matches played by $i$ up to time $t$ and $\delta, \eta, \sigma$ is parameters.

```{r}
# list detailing number of matches played for each player for every match
match_count <- list()

# Add new player to list and init #matches played to 0.
# Else, return #matches played for existing player.
get_match_count <- function(player) {
  if ( !player %in% names(match_count) ) {
    match_count[[player]] <<- 0
  }
  return (match_count[[player]])
}

# increment match count for a player
increment_match_count <- function(player) {
  match_count[[player]] <- match_count[[player]] + 1
} 

# hyper-parameters delta, eta, sigma
delta <- 20
eta <- 1
sigma <- 0.5
K_values <- numeric(nrow(df))

# calculate K value for each i match
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  # player names
  p1 <- df$player1_name[i]
  p2 <- df$player2_name[i]
  
  # number of matches played by both players until i-th match
  m1 <- get_match_count(p1)
  m2 <- get_match_count(p2)
  
  # K values for both player
  K1 <- delta / (m1 + eta)^sigma
  K2 <- delta / (m2 + eta)^sigma
  
  # combine both K values (average)
  K_values[[i]] <- (K1 + K2) / 2
  
  # increment match_count
  increment_match_count(p1)
  increment_match_count(p2)
}
```


```{r}
elo_tennis <- elo.run(
  score(player1_match_score, player2_match_score) ~ player1_name + player2_name,
  data = df,
  k = K_values
)

elo_tennis_df <- as.tibble(elo_tennis)
elo_tennis_df <- elo_tennis_df %>% 
  mutate(
    pre_elo_A = `elo.A` - `update.A`,
    pre_elo_B = `elo.B` - `update.B`)

```

# create new dataset with elo score and clean up
```{r}
df <- df %>% 
  cbind(
    elo_tennis_df$pre_elo_A, 
    elo_tennis_df$pre_elo_B) %>%
  mutate(
    player1_match_score = NULL,
    player2_match_score = NULL
  )

df <- df %>% rename(
    elo1 = `elo_tennis_df$pre_elo_A`,
    elo2 = `elo_tennis_df$pre_elo_B`
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    elo1, .before = rank_diff
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    elo2, .before = rank_diff
)

# extract elo_diff feature
df <- df %>%
  mutate(elo_diff = elo1 - elo2) %>%
  mutate(elo1 = NULL, elo2 = NULL) %>%
  relocate(elo_diff, .after = rank_diff) %>%
  filter(elo_diff != 0)


```

# save new dataset to as different file
```{r}
filenamepath <- glue::glue("./cleaned_data/{lubridate::today()}-atp_matches_best_of_3_ELO.rds")
write_rds(df,filenamepath)
```


```{r}
tb <- data.frame(
  team1 = c("A", "A", "B", "C","D"),
  team2 = c("B", "C", "C", "A","S"),
  score1 = c(1, 0, 1, 1,0),
  score2 = c(0, 1, 0, 0,1)
)
```

### dynamic K (update) factor
```{r}
# Initialize counters
player_counts <- list()

get_count <- function(player) {
  if (!player %in% names(player_counts)) {
    player_counts[[player]] <<- 0
  }
  return(player_counts[[player]])
}

increment_count <- function(player) {
  player_counts[[player]] <<- player_counts[[player]] + 1
}

delta <- 250
eta <- 5
sigma <- 0.4
K_values <- numeric(nrow(tb))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(tb))) {
  p1 <- tb$team1[i]
  p2 <- tb$team2[i]
  
  m1 <- get_count(p1)
  m2 <- get_count(p2)
  
  # Compute K for both players
  K1 <- delta / (m1 + eta)^sigma
  K2 <- delta / (m2 + eta)^sigma
  
  # Combine into one match K (common approach: average)
  K_values[i] <- (K1 + K2) / 2
  
  # Update match counts AFTER computing K
  increment_count(p1)
  increment_count(p2)
}

# Run elo.run with the function
elo_model <- elo.run(
  score(score1, score2) ~ team1 + team2,
  data = tb,
  k = K_values
)

elo_tb_df <- as.tibble(elo_model)
```
